select
o.dept_id as typeId,
o.charge_id as typeId,
o.shop_name as typeName,
o.category_id as typeId,
o.sku_no as typeName,
o.source_platform as typeName,
o.country_name_cn as typeName,
round(SUM (o.sales_amount_currency_rate),2) AS value,
round(SUM (o.sales_amount_cny_settle_rate),2) AS value,
round(SUM (o.sales_amount),2) AS value,
sum(o.sales_qty) as value,
to_char(o.date_time,'MM') as month
FROM dmp_order_delivery_report AS o
FROM dmp_order_create_report AS o
and o.date_time >= #{lastsMonth} group by month
,o.dept_id
,o.charge_id
,o.shop_name
,o.category_id
,o.sku_no
,o.source_platform
,o.country_name_cn
